snippet.title: Nioh 3 - Gameplay Showcase
snippet.description:
Visit the website: https://bit.ly/Nioh3GameplayUK
 
Conquer the Crucible, Become Shogun. 
 
Nioh 3 is currently in development and is scheduled to release 6th February 2026. 
 
Dive into the world of Nioh 3 with this gameplay preview showcasing unique yokai, historical heroes, samurai and ninja-style combat, and the Crucible. 
 
The Nioh 3 demo launches 29th January 2026 on PlayStation®5 and Steam®. Complete the demo to receive the Twin-Snake Helmet reward, and carry your save file to the full game.
 
Follow us: 
X: https://x.com/koeitecmoeurope
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/koeitecmoeurope
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/koeitecmogames
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/KTEurope
 
*Screens are taken from an in-development version.
